title: It Happened One Night
description: A newsman (Clark Gable) rides a bus and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Walter Connolly) runaway daughter (Claudette Colbert).

title: Good Neighbor Sam
description: A San Francisco adman (Jack Lemmon) poses as his wife's friend's (Romy Schneider) husband so that she can inherit $15 million.

title: The Caine Mutiny
description: A World War II Naval officer is court-martialed for relieving paranoid Capt. Queeg of command during a typhoon.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: Dr. Strangelove Or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
description: President Muffley and his advisers man the Pentagon war room, as planes with bombs head toward Moscow.

title: The Running Man
description: An insurance man (Alan Bates) gets chummy in Spain with a couple (Laurence Harvey, Lee Remick) who have collected on a fake death.

title: We Were Strangers
description: A Cuban (Jennifer Jones) lets a rebel (John Garfield) use her home as a base for digging a tunnel to blow up a dictatorship.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: Only Angels Have Wings
description: A sassy chorus girl (Jean Arthur) falls in love with a seat-of-the-pants pilot (Cary Grant) in South America.

title: The Harder They Fall
description: A fight promoter (Rod Steiger) hires a hard-luck sportswriter (Humphrey Bogart) to hype a simple Argentine boxer for the mob.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).

title: The Long Gray Line
description: On the eve of his retirement, an Irish immigrant looks back upon his lifetime of service to West Point military academy.

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: 5 Against the House
description: Friends (Guy Madison, Kim Novak, Brian Keith) join a college student's scheme to rob a Reno casino for kicks.

title: Cactus Flower
description: A dentist (Walter Matthau) has his prim assistant (Ingrid Bergman) pose as his wife to discourage his kooky girlfriend (Goldie Hawn).

title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
description: A World War II widow (Rosalind Russell) overcomes a mental block thanks to one (Melvyn Douglas) of the five soldiers her husband died for.

title: Middle of the Night
description: A widowed manufacturer (Fredric March) falls in love with a divorced employee (Kim Novak) 30 years his junior.

title: Pal Joey
description: A singer (Frank Sinatra) flirts with a chorus girl (Kim Novak) from Albuquerque after a San Francisco socialite (Rita Hayworth) buys him a nightclub.

title: Autumn Leaves
description: A New England spinster (Joan Crawford) marries a younger man (Cliff Robertson) who has mental problems and another wife (Vera Miles).

title: Scandal Sheet
description: When a New York tabloid editor (Broderick Crawford) accidentally kills his wife, his best reporters (Donna Reed, John Derek) figure it out.

title: Port Afrique
description: An American (Phil Carey) returns to Morocco and discovers his wife's past while probing her death.

title: Human Desire
description: An Oklahoma train engineer's (Glenn Ford) lover (Gloria Grahame) wants him to kill her husband (Broderick Crawford).

title: The Mating of Millie
description: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

title: Jason and the Argonauts
description: The Greek hero (Todd Armstrong) sails through Harpies and clashing rocks to the Golden Fleece, guarded by the Hydra.

title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond
description: A bookie's (William Holden) innocent new secretary (Lucille Ball) thinks she's working in a real-estate office.

title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
description: A bachelor (Dean Martin) tries to save his buddy's (Eli Wallach) marriage by stealing his mistress, who is not who he thinks.

title: His Girl Friday
description: An ace reporter's editor, her ex-husband, tries everything possible to stop her from remarrying someone else.

title: The Bitter Tea of General Yen
description: A U.S. missionary (Barbara Stanwyck) is gradually seduced by a courtly warlord (Nils Asther) holding her in Shanghai.

title: Operation Mad Ball
description: An Army private (Jack Lemmon) and his buddies try to fraternize with nurses who are off-limits as officers.

title: Craig's Wife
description: A woman's (Rosalind Russell) obsession with neatness and material goods drives out her husband (John Boles), family and servants.

title: Gidget Grows Up
description: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

title: Boots Malone
description: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training.

title: The Game That Kills
description: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

title: Berserk
description: Scotland Yard looks into spiking, buzz sawing and knifing at ringmaster Monica's traveling circus.

title: Born Yesterday
description: A scrap-metal tycoon (Broderick Crawford) pays a Washington newsman (William Holden) to make his girlfriend (Judy Holliday) couth.

title: Phffft!
description: Being with a blonde (Kim Novak) and a bachelor makes a divorced lawyer (Jack Lemmon) and TV writer (Judy Holliday) want to be back together.

title: Three on a Couch
description: An artist tries to help his psychiatrist fiancée by posing as suitors for her lovesick patients.

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: The Caine Mutiny
description: A World War II Naval officer is court-martialed for relieving paranoid Capt. Queeg of command during a typhoon.

title: The Silencers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) stops a Chinese villain's atomic plot in the first of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
description: Sinbad the sailor (Kerwin Mathews) needs the egg of a giant two-headed bird of prey to restore a shrunken princess (Kathryn Grant).
